rationale: The plan matches the reference on every design point: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts for an unpaired single-batch 3-vs-3, blind-VST PCA and distance heatmap with an explicit outlier policy, a minimal ≥10-in-≥3 filter, median-of-ratios inside the model, ~condition with control releveled and the contrast stated, BH at 0.05 set in results() with apeglm shrinkage, and a clear power caveat. Enrichment follows the ortholog-map path correctly (babelgene one-to-one, mapped share reported, full Wald-stat ranked list, Hallmark with version, 15-500 window) and honestly flags the absence of a zebrafish collection and the thinness of GO. Minor deductions: the parallel goseq GO path is an over-representation test that sits awkwardly beside the plan's own rule against ORA on a short list, its universe is only implied, and gene lengths for the goseq offset are not sourced; the report promises to state the Ensembl release but never names it.
